_readme: Pages whose scholarships must not be listed, found by checking the site by hand. A record is dropped when its page address starts with a prefix here. Add a line and give the reason.

urlPrefixes.why: A list of outside funders. Many fund study in other countries (for example Gates Cambridge), not at Purdue or in the United States.
Amelia Earhart Fellowships are for women doing a PhD in aerospace science. Judged from the name, not checked on the page.
LMU-CSC is, as far as we know, for doctoral candidates and visiting researchers. Not checked on the page. Remove this line if the page says Bachelor's or Master's.
PROMOS funds German students going abroad (outbound).
For students already enrolled who need help finishing, not for new applicants.
A researcher fellowship for people from Denmark, not a degree scholarship.
The John Monash Scholarship sends Australians to study abroad (outbound).
Heriot-Watt Dubai campus. Our UK list covers study in the UK.
For people seeking sanctuary in the UK, not for applicants from abroad. Judged from the name; remove this line if the page says otherwise.
